items.title: JPMorgan Built a Version of JEPI Designed to Keep the IRS Waiting
items.summary: JEPI's monthly income has made it a default choice for yield-hungry investors, but a quiet tax problem erodes those payouts for anyone holding shares in a taxable account. JPMorgan just launched two sibling funds designed to shift when the IRS collects, and the tradeoffs are not obvious.

items.title: The Biggest Risk To Cerebras Systems Stock Is Sitting Inside Its Backlog
items.summary: The order book that makes Cerebras look de-risked came from a single deal, and the hyperscaler partnerships meant to broaden it are not yet producing revenue.

items.title: Is Broadcom (AVGO) Stock a Buy Before Its Q3 Earnings?
items.summary: Broadcom is scheduled to report results for its fiscal third quarter after-market hours on Wednesday, September 2, with Wall Street looking for another quarter of exceptional growth.

items.title: VGT’s $58 Billion AI Chip Concentration Could Derail Your 2027 Returns
items.summary: VGT carries 324 holdings, but a closer look at its semiconductor sleeve reveals a fund that behaves nothing like the diversified tech vehicle most investors think they own, and the stakes heading into 2027 are far higher than the label suggests.

items.title: Not Nvidia, Not AMD. Micron Could Be September's Biggest AI Winner or Loser.
items.summary: Micron Technology will report its quarterly results in September, and recent results from AI chipmakers suggest it could easily exceed expectations.

items.title: Nvidia Looks Like a Growth Stock Again. Why the Chip Maker Is a Bargain.
items.summary: Nvidia  stock is back in fashion.  For evidence the chip maker is once again attracting growth-hungry investors, look no further than ARK Invest’s Cathie Wood.  After its recent blowout earnings,  Nvidia  should be able to shed fears that it is too big to grow at a rapid rate.

items.title: Wall Street Is Looking Here. I’m Looking Somewhere Else
items.summary: Everyone is chasing the same AI trade, but one chipmaker sitting in NVIDIA's shadow just posted 50% revenue growth and landed commitments worth gigawatts from two of the biggest names in tech. The real question is whether the valuation leaves any room to be wrong.

items.title: How Investors Are Reacting To Cisco Systems (CSCO) Expanding Sovereign AI Infrastructure In Saudi Arabia
items.summary: In recent days, AMD, Cisco and HUMAIN detailed plans to expand their joint AI infrastructure in Saudi Arabia to as much as 1 GW by 2030, while Cisco also introduced a Sovereign Critical Infrastructure portfolio in Canada for air-gapped, on‑premises deployments across key sectors. Taken together, these moves show Cisco pushing deeper into sovereign AI and critical infrastructure, targeting customers that need high‑performance compute alongside strict data residency and control.
